title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-eu0i: allow_no_piv_response field is dead code
description:
The allow_no_piv_response boolean field on Context is set in at least 8 locations (Context::new(), register_fresh(), restore_existing(), new_fresh(), new_ephemeral(), restore(), from_sender_state() etc.) but is never read in any conditional anywhere in lib.rs. This means:
- restored contexts cannot actually reject responses without PIV (tests that expect this fail)
- The field serves no purpose
- Tests named "restored_context_rejects_response_without_piv" and "supplied_material_restores_authoritative_state_and_disables_no_piv" expect behavior this field cannot enforce because it is dead.
